title: Resolution declaring November 25 a day against violence against women
summary: This resolution declares November 25 as the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women in honor of the Mirabal sisters, three Dominican activists assassinated in 1960. It notes that in New York City women make up 57.4% of domestic violence homicide victims and Black women account for 33.7% of intimate partner homicides despite being 13% of the population. The resolution affirms the City's commitment to addressing gender-based violence.
